Summary: Prevents triage from moving forward with unstated severity, unnamed responders, or vague impact framing.
PassCriteria: Severity, responders, impact hypothesis, and first actions are documented explicitly in the triage note.
FailCriteria: Severity, responders, impact, or first actions are implied only through chat or memory.
EscalationRule: Pause progression until the triage note is explicit and replayable.
